pgvector

C 12.5k 1.0k

About

pgvector is an open-source vector similarity search extension for PostgreSQL.

It supports exact and approximate nearest neighbor search, and works well with PostgreSQL.

Features

  • Exact and approximate (HNSW) nearest neighbor search
  • Supports l2, inner product, and cosine distance
  • Available in SQL and client libraries

Getting Started

CREATE EXTENSION vector;

Scales to millions of rows with HNSW indexes.
